subject: CleverPay livechat: elevated streaming latency — escalation and mitigation
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cleverpay.com>
To: support@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@cleverpay.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Livechat stream latency spike (SF peak)

Hi team,

We started seeing severe delays in our livechat streaming responses around 09:15 PDT this morning. Instead of incremental tokens arriving every 200-300ms, we often see 2–6s gaps, and a few sessions stalled entirely (no more tokens after initial prompt). This is affecting our checkout support flow — conversion impact is visible.

What we observed:
- A3 instances serving us showed higher p95 latency; session traces attached (telemetry-sample-20260604.csv).
- Problem persisted across regions (SF primary, us-west-2 fallback) for ~30 minutes.

Can you confirm if there's an ongoing incident and what the recommended immediate mitigations are? We can change client-side behavior if you suggest short-term configs.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform Engineering
CleverPay

From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cleverpay.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Livechat stream latency spike (SF peak)

Hi Samir — thanks for the report and the telemetry. We're looking into it now and have opened SUP-3287. Short update and immediate mitigations you can apply while we triage: 

Short-term mitigation recommendations (client-side):
1) Switch to non-streaming responses for high-priority checkout flows (set stream=false) — this avoids token-by-token dependence when the network path is experiencing stalls.
2) Reduce max_tokens by 20% for streaming sessions to shrink average token emission time.
3) Implement exponential backoff for reconnects (start 250ms, max 3s) and accept partial responses; we can fill any missing content via follow-up generation.
4) Use per-session routing to your us-west-2 Dedicated pool (if you have it) until we confirm host-level issues.

We're also running a focused investigation on serving layer slowdowns. Ben is coordinating a temporary traffic reroute and will update within 30 minutes. We'll attach findings and a timeline when available.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Livechat stream latency spike (SF peak)

Quick ops note and what we changed:

What happened (summary):
- Around 09:12 PDT a recent rollout (model variant v3.1.7 with a new attention-kernel) caused degraded token emission performance on a subset of our A3 fleet in us-west-1 and us-west-2 edge shards. The degradation appears input-length sensitive and shows up as intermittent multi-second token gaps.

Immediate actions taken by Redwood:
- Rolled back v3.1.7 on affected pools at 09:25 PDT — this restored normal token cadence for the majority of sessions.
- Applied a short-term routing policy to prefer dedicated routing for CleverPay sessions while we complete a deeper kernel analysis.
- Throttled background batch jobs that were contending for IO on the same host.

Customer impact and next steps:
- Impact window: 09:12 — 09:40 PDT. We estimate ~18% of CleverPay streaming sessions experienced degraded pacing (based on your telemetry and our logs).
- Short-term for CleverPay: keep non-streaming fallback for checkout until EOD; we will monitor.
- Engineering action: kernel performance regression reproduction is in progress; ETA for patch candidate 48 hours.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute bridge to walk through the telemetry and the rollback timeline.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cleverpay.com>, rachel.kim@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 07 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Incident summary & next steps — CleverPay streaming latency 2026-06-04

Hi Samir / Priya — following up with the agreed post-incident summary and recommended remediation steps. Thank you for the detailed traces — they were instrumental.

Incident summary:
- Timeline: 09:12 PDT (deploy of v3.1.7) → 09:25 rollback → 09:40 majority recovery.
- Root cause: a performance regression in a new attention kernel under specific input-length distributions that amplified token emission jitter on a subset of edge shards.
- Impact: ~18% of streaming sessions for CleverPay experienced intermittent multi-second token gaps; session stall rate <1%.

What we did for you:
- Immediate rollback and routing preference to Dedicated pool for your livechat traffic.
- Temporary credit offer: Redwood is proposing a 10% invoice credit for June usage while we complete the full RCA (we can convert to a formal credit note if you agree).
- Action items assigned: SUP-3287 (ops timeline and raw traces), ENG-9156 (kernel regression fix), QE-4022 (regression test coverage).

Recommended customer actions (short and medium term):
- Short: keep checkout on non-streaming mode until ENG-9156 is deployed; enable client-side reconnect backoff as discussed.
- Medium: add a post-token-timeout guard that triggers a lightweight follow-up generation in non-streaming mode after 1.5s of inactivity. This preserves experience without full reliance on streaming.

Proposed cadence:
- Engineering patch candidate by 2026-06-06 (we will validate with your sample payloads).
- Joint verification run the morning of 2026-06-07 in a low-traffic window.
- Final RCA and public postmortem by 2026-06-10.

Would you like to take the 30-minute bridge tomorrow at 10:00 PDT for verification? If so, we'll send an invite and include ENG and QE.

Thanks again for your patience — we take these incidents seriously and are prioritizing the regression fix and added test coverage.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference
